name: Content at Scale
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Content at Scale, assemble a rigorous source-grounded content workflow without claiming its proprietary optimization stack. The hard boundary is opaque enterprise packaging, proprietary models, and managed content operations, plus workflow, data, and model tuning.
